note: String Field Formatter provides one @FieldFormatter plugin, plain_string_formatter (class PlainStringFormatter extends core StringFormatter), for the string and string_long field types. It adds two settings on top of the core string formatter: wrap_tag (select of HTML tags; default _none = no wrapper) and wrap_class (space/comma separated CSS classes). Settings live in the entity_view_display config entity component (schema field.formatter.settings.plain_string_formatter). No config form/permissions/Drush/services of its own. Medium/hard cases are grounded in real formatter settings on namespaced field_sff_* string fields on the Article view display.

evals.prompt: I want to render a plain-text (string) field wrapped in an <h2> tag on display without writing a Twig template. Which module/formatter does this, what is the formatter's machine id, and which field types can use it?
evals.expected_output: Use String Field Formatter's 'Plain string formatter' (id plain_string_formatter), available on string and string_long fields. It can wrap the value in a chosen HTML tag such as h2.

evals.prompt: What two extra display settings does the String Field Formatter's plain_string_formatter add compared with the core string formatter, and what is the default of the wrapper-tag setting?
evals.expected_output: It adds wrap_tag (Wrapper tag; a select of HTML tags, default _none meaning no wrapper) and wrap_class (space/comma-separated CSS classes for the wrapper). With _none the output matches the core string formatter.

evals.prompt: When I set a string field to use the Plain string formatter with a wrapper tag and classes, where is that configuration stored in Drupal?
evals.expected_output: In the field's component of the bundle's entity_view_display config entity (core.entity_view_display.<entity>.<bundle>.<view_mode>), under content.<field>.settings.wrap_tag / wrap_class, with type plain_string_formatter. You set it on the bundle's Manage display page.

evals.prompt: On this site the Article content type has a string field 'field_sff_known' displayed with the String Field Formatter. Inspect the live default view display and state which HTML wrapper tag it wraps the value in.
evals.expected_output: It wraps the value in an <h2>: core.entity_view_display.node.article.default content.field_sff_known has type plain_string_formatter with settings.wrap_tag: h2.

evals.prompt: The Article field 'field_sff_cls' uses the Plain string formatter on the default display. Inspect the live configuration and tell me the CSS classes configured for its wrapper element.
evals.expected_output: The wrapper classes are 'highlight badge' (settings.wrap_class), with wrap_tag span, in core.entity_view_display.node.article.default content.field_sff_cls.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the Article content type has a string field 'field_sff_task' that currently uses the default string formatter on the default view display. Using the String Field Formatter module, change its display so the field is rendered with the Plain string formatter and wrapped in an HTML tag (not 'none'). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.node.article.default the field_sff_task component has type plain_string_formatter with settings.wrap_tag set to a real tag (e.g. h3), not _none.

evals.prompt: I already display the Article field 'field_sff_head' with the Plain string formatter but it has no wrapper tag. Make it output as a top-level <h1> heading, and save it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.node.article.default the field_sff_head component has type plain_string_formatter with settings.wrap_tag: h1.
